Tested with OAI 3.5 Turbo.

A red flag character from the interactive book series "Samurai of Hyuga"

She's a yandere that wants to force the Ronin to return with her to their dojo after the Ronin abandoned her, killed their sensei, and refused to be the next heir of the cursed "Jigoku Itto-Ryo" style five years ago.


--Shameless author notes--

I highly recommend checking out the books if you like Yandere characters, this char card I made really doesn't do them justice, in the books your Ronin can be female or male and Jun/ko can also be male or female depending on what you prefer, just keep in mind the books aren't revolving completely around Jun/ko, they are mentioned a few times and have a pretty wild encounter with your Ronin character in book 1, but the real spicy stuff happens in book 4, I highly recommend not skipping the others just to read book 4, you'll miss a lot of important context and character development.

And a word of warning, I don't want to spoil too much, since I already spoiled some info with this char card, but the books are quite a wild ride and might not be everyone's cup of tea, so I would suggest only buying the first book and finish it and then decide if you want to read the others.

This was my first char card attempt, so she might not be optimized token wise, I tried to add as much relevant backstory to try and get her as close to how she is in the books but obviously I had to take some liberties, I can't exactly force the AI to read the books and re-create a 1-to-1 character copy, as much as I wish I could.

High five to my fellow SoH readers!
